entry_points.text: Interrupt acknowledge requires group match, mask above candidate and active above preemption, else spurious; success activates entry, records priority and returns identifier.
Timer fast path serves control, compare and count with direct or emulated views and offset fixup; exits dispatch common classes; panic and unexpected entries never return after restoring host state.
Trace control exposes decimal event-injection write, clock display, and callbacks for init, buffer lifecycle, toggling, reader management and gating.
Data-abort path decodes syndrome, tries in-kernel bus handling, else stages user exit; kernel success advances past the instruction.

exports.text: Stage2 offers range flush, detached create and range split; flush fast-paths on writeback capability else walks leaves, create validates and builds, split walks then barriers.
Nested stage-one invalidation takes optional stage-two context plus address and encoded op, serving recognized families and rejecting others.
Host fault injection offers synchronous abort plus exclusive-atomic and size-fault variants, delegating to nested handling when appropriate.
Register-width store helper writes 1, 2, 4 or 8 byte values into a byte buffer via width-matched temporaries.
Cache and TLB maintenance spans range, slot, whole VM and nested roots, with protected mode routed via hypervisor calls.
Write protection spans range, slot with TLB invalidate, and all valid nested roots with control refresh.

hazards.text: Detached create fails on misalign, untranslatable protection or exhaustion with cleanup; width helper defines only four widths; splitter may pause with partial work; probe replays on race.
Hypervisor panic never returns, deactivating traps when a VCPU runs before reporting saved state and abort addresses.
Trace load fails safely on overflow, zero size, allocation failure or hypervisor rejection without leaking; clock math widens near 64-bit overflow.
APR count is power of two from preemption bits; idle priority is 255; nested exclusion combines traps; trace windows use 600s max, 100ms init and 500ms update.
Feature bitmap widths are low-bit masks; arch SMC ranges cover version-to-top and zero-to-top; feature level occupies low four bits.
32-bit fault encoding uses distinct LPAE and non-LPAE external-abort values with LPAE-format and extended-address bits.
Guest exit interface provides distinct reasons for standard emulation, no-syndrome handling and large load-store, plus a device bus identifier.

invariants.text: Flush skips non-cacheable leaves and cleans cacheable ones; create walks a synthetic granule interval; split expands tables or single page; reclaim drops refs and clears only on last ref; per-level needs are fixed.
Priority handling derives preemption from binary points, combines active banks with offset scaling, and dispatches APR banks by group with running and pending views.
Enable, mask and control accesses proxy VM control fields with mode synthesis; end-of-interrupt count bumps a hypervisor control field.

Timer status compares compare against counter; CPACR, ZCR, IMPDEF and TLBI traps apply only in narrow contexts; TLBI normalizes families, assumes guest barrier, and enters VMID only when context is supplied.
Clock enable snapshots, clears calibration, schedules first update and waits, while disable cancels pending work.

Mappings skip protected mode; backing scales with size plus per-CPU page; sharing walks rings with unwind; enable toggles clock then hypervisor with rollback; event gating forwards or updates atomically.

Firmware list orders PSCI, workarounds and bitmaps; fault address follows target level and EASE; 64-bit aborts rewalk and may abandon; 32-bit preserves half address; SEA target and exclusive synthesis delegate appropriately.
Invalid-decode aborts inject for protected guests, exit distinctly when no-syndrome handling is enabled, else fail; load-store class with type field always takes the large-access exit.

Split estimates tables and pauses on resched need, lock contention or low cache, revalidating root; alloc and free pair accounting; unlinked tables free after grace with level carried across callback.

User probe disables interrupts, replays on missing leaf or race, else reports block size; protected topup lazily allocates; dirty enable protects masked span and splits; huge mapping needs alignment and containment; tags guard by type and mode.

locks.text: Synchronous external abort injection requires the caller to hold the virtual CPU mutex.

Whole-machine flush holds source read and address-space write locks; nested flush and protect, chunked split and dirty enable require address-space write already held; per-slot split and protect acquire it internally.

state_machines.text: List-register scan keeps used pending entries with group enabled and strictly lowest priority; active set converts and sets bank bit while clear drops lowest; deactivation and end-of-interrupt bump or drop with group checks.

Exception-return fast path skips for new nested hardware or nested context, gates user return on mode plus trap, demotes hypervisor return, authenticates signed variants, then installs sanitized state.
VHE system-register traps are offered in fixed order to invalidation, timer, CPACR, ZCR then generic, with first claimant winning.

Clock worker snapshots, warns on drift, recomputes conversion, publishes and reschedules with epoch fast-forward near overflow; buffer load rejects double load and unwinds in reverse, unload validates identity before teardown.
Device access ends in kernel-complete, userspace emulate, no-syndrome exit, large-access exit, or guest abort, distinguished by return and counters.

structs.text: Host per-CPU state, hypervisor CPU context and vector are per-CPU; invalidation context saves flags plus translation and control copies with optional stage-two table.
Trace clock stores counter, epoch, multiplier, shift, work and completion; host buffer handle stores descriptor pointer and size.

Hypervisor address globals hold root with mutex, idmap interval with vector, address width and device base, read-only after init; sharing tracker holds frame, count and tree node with guarded empty root.
Stage-two ops bind alloc, free, deferred release, refcount, translation and cache maintenance; user walker binds translation only.
